# Overalls

> Overalls is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted platform for persistent Firecracker microVM development machines. There is no hosted service; you run it on your own x86_64 bare-metal hardware with NixOS. Source: https://github.com/ghuntley/overalls

## Site

- [Home](https://overalls.dev/index.html): what Overalls is, features with status labels (STABLE, PREVIEW, EXPERIMENTAL), FAQ
- [Architecture](https://overalls.dev/architecture.html): components (Marshall, Lilly, Porsche, Audi, Brady, Enrico, Galileo, Ziggy, Lyra), control plane, machine lifecycle, guest edge services

## Self-hosting guide

- [Overview and requirements](https://overalls.dev/self-host/index.html)
- [Provision a host](https://overalls.dev/self-host/provision.html): `nix run .#host -- discover | plan | install | enroll | verify`
- [Deploy the control plane](https://overalls.dev/self-host/deploy.html): NixOS modules, secrets, PostgreSQL, SMTP, TLS
- [Enroll hosts and images](https://overalls.dev/self-host/enroll.html): Lilly credentials, guest images, Porsche gateway
- [Your first machine](https://overalls.dev/self-host/first-machine.html): sign in, SSH keys, CLI, repository launch
- [Day-two operations](https://overalls.dev/self-host/operations.html): updates, drains, relocation, backups, logs

## Repository documentation

- [Operator docs](https://github.com/ghuntley/overalls/tree/main/docs)
- [Architecture decision records](https://github.com/ghuntley/overalls/tree/main/docs/architecture/decisions)
